rationale: The best line already wins with a tiny two-block recurrent tail. This change keeps that family intact but swaps the recurrent pass anchor from the original token embedding state to the normalized pre-recurrence decoder state, so the extra tail pass refines the late representation instead of repeatedly mixing against raw input embeddings. It is compile-stable, adds no meaningful bytes, and directly targets an underexplored recurrence-structure variant rather than another small hyperparameter replay.
title: Normalized Local Anchor For Recurrent Tail
